reason: I already reorder my own brand when it runs out and my drawer is full of half-used bottles. I don't need another one to sit there.
objection: Is it really tested, or just marketing? A named lab and a report sound good, but I have no way to know the QR report is real, and I'm not switching from what I already take.
would_change_my_mind: If my current magnesium ran out and I saw the lab report for the batch actually check out, I might try one box at the launch price.
